payload.title: File:Hybodus hauffianus.png
payload.description_html: A life reconstruction of a female and male Hybodus hauffianus, based primarily on the skull and horn arrangement proposed by Maisey (1982, 1986, 1987) and on complete body fossils of H. hauffianus, also figured by Maisey. Reconstruction also in accordance with Asteracanthus. Venus and Mars symbols from public domain.
